sentences.text: Gymnotrachelus is an extinct genus containing a single species of large selenosteid arthrodire placoderm.
This animal belongs to the class Placodermi, the family Selenosteidae within the clade Aspinothoracidi, and its type species is Gymnotrachelus hydei.

Gymnotrachelus lived during the Late Devonian period, specifically the Famennian stage, between 365.2 and 358.86 million years ago. The only known fossils come from the Late Famennian Cleveland Shale in Ohio.
A 2022 study by Jobbins et al. identified Gymnotrachelus as an outgroup to the genera Heintzichthys and Gorgonichthys.
